description: List the dated changes in apiwatch's feed from today forward, soonest first: model retirements, breaking API changes, silent behavior changes and deprecation key dates. Use it to plan migrations. Optionally limit to the next N days (default 90, max 365) or one vendor. Max 50 records.

vendor.description: Only this vendor, for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Stripe

name: list_upcoming

date_passed.description: True when the key date is today or earlier (UTC)

scope.description: Empty when the record applies to every caller; otherwise where it applies

title: List upcoming changes
